app.name: Haunted Hollow
app.short_description: A spooky roller-coaster shooter for 1-4 Wii Remotes
app.long_description: Ride a cart through a blocky haunted house and pop ghosts, bats, pumpkins, flying books, skeletons and spiders into candy, then beat the Pumpkin King. Point your Wii Remote and press B or A to shoot, + to start, HOME to pause.
